summary:
Architectural design and execution plan for the Mobile Harness Live Agent Experience & Core UI Overhaul:
- Live Voice Mode with continuous STT, local neural/system TTS engine, camera frame streaming for vision-capable agents, keyboard input, and voice settings.
- Agent Activity Normalization & Execution Visualization (reading, editing, creating, running commands, thinking events, skill usage).
- Project Artifact Viewer panel with created/modified files, generated images, documents, and code previews.
- Advanced Markdown rendering with LaTeX math ($...$, $$...$$), tables, and universal syntax-highlighted code blocks.
- Real Steer Mode without process termination and FIFO Persistent Message Queue with pause/resume and editing.
- Agent and Subscription cleanup removing Hermes/OpenClaw from subscription provider lists.
- Mobile Terminal overhaul with compact contextual command bar and keyboard optimization.
- Multi-language Syntax Highlighting engine and Rust DevStack toolchain installation.
